post.description:
Always answers the same 202 for valid phones.

400 codes: `invalid_phone`, `invalid_request`. 403: `csrf_failed`.
400 codes: `invalid_request`. 404: `not_found` (not a member of the crew).

patch.description: Any active member of the crew may update. 400 codes: `invalid_request`.

put.description: Sets the caller's own RSVP, creating their participation when missing.

get.description: Defaults: every status but `discarded`, newest first (max 500). 400: `invalid_request`.

post.description:
`url` or `title` is required. 400: `invalid_request`, `invalid_url`, `ignored_url`,
`invalid_dates`. 409: `duplicate_proposal` (+ `proposal_id`). The link preview is
`pending` in the response; it is unfurled off the request.

patch.description:
Partial edit; `est_price`, the dates and `booking_ref` accept `null` to clear them.
Editing `category` marks it as the user's choice. 400: `invalid_request`, `invalid_dates`.

post.description: The same status is a no-op. 409: `invalid_transition`.

delete.description: Only the author deletes a comment: 403 `forbidden` for any other member.

post.description:
Queues a new unfurl. 409: `refresh_too_soon` (pending, or fetched in the last 10 minutes).
404 also when the proposal has no link.

get.description: `200 image/webp` (private, one day). 404 without a thumbnail or without access.
